#019 · Mouse Pokémon

Rattata

Normal

Kanto · Generation 1

Rattata is a Normal-type Mouse Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 3.5 kg. It evolves into Raticate. Its highest base stat is Speed (72), with a base stat total of 253.
